Pree, the ticket is #8841. I replied in your thread in #central-random.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. He didn't name the customer in that message. He was talking about "Tobias's dealer account" in the Plains depots, and Marrow Fieldworks is the Plains dealer account he owns.

In the reply I also pointed out MFW-218 so you don't confuse the two. That's an older Marrow Fieldworks ticket from April about appointments moving between doors 4 and 6 at the west receiving entrance, not this Door 2 issue.
